target.jobTitle: Senior Business Process Automation Expert (AI Training Project)

sourceResume.summary: Automation engineer who builds production workflow systems and the failure science around them. I operate a live n8n estate and a 28-connector MCP automation plane on cron, with a standing discipline: proposed, executed, verified — every consequential action independently checked before any completion claim.

experience.title: Automation Engineer
bullets: Built n8n failure labs modeling quote-to-cash, lead routing, and AP workflows: 28 adversarial test cases per suite with end-state assertions proving no invoice issued, no payment attempted, and no customer messaged on any failure path.
Ran RED-to-GREEN failure analysis in n8n: retained a real failed execution (email regex escaping bug), fixed the root cause, and re-ran the suite green with independent readback checks.
Migrated 1404 files with zero failures using a ledger-based resume worker; classified 1299 unrecoverable files by root cause into quarantine with bounded retry instead of infinite retry loops.
Operate a scheduled watcher fleet on cron with silent-when-healthy contracts, idempotent checks, and streak tracking — near-zero alert noise across hourly and daily runs.

Built and operated a 28-connector MCP automation estate over production surfaces (file storage, messaging, calendars) with explicit proposed/executed/verified state transitions on every consequential write.

projects.name: Automation Failure Index
projects.description: Live catalog of business-process automation failure modes, each with detection signal, recovery pattern, and proof.
bullets: Catalogued recurring failure modes from ~3000 development cycles: lost context at handoffs, wrong-record routing, duplicate actions after ambiguous timeouts, and silent partial failures from rate limits and truncated downloads.
Each mode ships with a runnable RED case, the GREEN fix, and assertions that guard the end state.
